chapter_theme: The marks of the Supreme (பரலட்சணம்): Siva stands beyond the states and the tattvas and is not bound by adjuncts, yet with Shakti as his body and form he pervades the five elements and the worlds. The soul that leaves its darkness becomes one with him, and Nandi as guru cuts away fear and gives himself.
structure_note: The chapter alternates the Supreme in himself (2452 to 2455, 2462 to 2464) with Nandi's grace to the speaker (2456, 2457) and Shakti as his body (2459, 2464), and ends with the yogi for whom tapas becomes grace (2465).

2452.reading: Nandi, in the state beyond, stands apart from all; the soul in that beyond-state is without knowing; the abiding soul that gains understanding and leaves its darkness becomes one, and as the supreme soul it settles in the Lord.
2452.nuance: அதீதம் (the state beyond) is said of both: for Nandi it is transcendence, for the soul it is traditionally taken as its state of utter unknowing before grace. பதியிற் பதியும் plays on பதி, the Lord, and பதிதல, to settle or be imprinted.

2453.reading: The rare Lord without beginning or end, the supreme flame of light, appears and yet does not appear, and stands as the right order; those who have known that long supreme knowledge are the blessed.
2453.nuance: தோன்றத் தோன்றாமையின் can be read as his appearing without appearing, or as the world not appearing once his light appears. நீதி is order or justice; புண்ணியத்தோர் are those whose merit has ripened.

2454.reading: For those who can enter the well of Om and reach the great Lord who dances in the hall, in the state beyond turiya where turiya itself is contained, by a rare yoga, there is no flaw.
2454.nuance: துரியாதீதம் is the state beyond turiya. வியோகம் can be viyoga, separation from the bonds, or a heightened yoga. துரிய in the last line chimes with turiya and is taken as 'to enter or plunge'; துரிசு is fault.

2455.reading: As whiteness changes when red stands before it, so the soul, coming within that true Supreme, in the empty void of knowledge that has swallowed the false world, becomes the flag that joins the red Siva-Meru.
2455.nuance: The image is the crystal that takes the colour of what is near it, a classic Siddhanta figure for the soul taking on what it stands beside. மேரு is traditionally the crown of the yogic body; கொடி may be flag or creeper.

2456.reading: So that the tattvas from kala onward that were set on me perish, cutting at the root the two mayas as things apart, so that I become one with the truth that is the highest Parasiva, Nandi cut away my fear and took me as his own.
2456.nuance: இருமாயை are traditionally pure and impure maya. The verse credits release to Nandi's act, not to the speaker's effort: ஆண்டவன், he who ruled me.

2457.reading: My Nandi, who made me fit to know myself, knew me and led me to the place beyond knowing, then came forth in light as his own form and gave himself to me as the Supreme beyond.
2457.nuance: என்னை அறிந்து may be Nandi knowing me or me knowing myself under him; அறியாத இடம், the place not known, is the state beyond ordinary knowing. தன்னை அளித்தான், he gave himself, is the climax.

2458.reading: Expanding and contracting, he becomes earth, water and air, the unceasing wind, the sun and the moon, and the way of dharma, and stands bearing the one sky.
2458.nuance: The list should run through the five elements, but வாயு and வளி both mean air and fire is missing; one may be a corruption. அரந்த may be Hara's, or what removes sorrow.

2459.reading: Shakti, who in the state of being became one with him, stands as Tatpara; as the body of the Supreme who is himself, she takes on the distinctions of will, knowledge and the rest that she brings forth, and daily moves and dances in great love.
2459.nuance: That Shakti is Siva's body (உடல்) is a Siddhanta teaching; இச்சை, ஞானம் and the unstated கிரியை are her three powers. நடத்தும் நடிக்கும் may be 'conducts and dances' or one act said twice.

2460.reading: Bindu, nursed within Para as Para, reaches above, below and the sides, and the body, mouth, eyes and nose; the bindu that brings the knowing of taste becomes the doing of the undisciplined soul.
2460.nuance: The verse is obscure. நான்சுவை may be 'four tastes' or 'I-taste', and சீலமிலா அணு, the soul without discipline, may mean the bound soul in general. The plain sense is that bindu, born in Shakti, runs through the senses and so into the soul's acts.

2461.reading: In this body, as with that separate nature, the adjuncts become all the tattvas; maya, lit as brightness by the supreme light that stirs it, becomes sensation, breathes, eats and sleeps.
2461.nuance: ஆறாம் may be 'sixth' or 'that becomes'. The point, as tradition reads it, is that maya is inert and acts only as lit by Siva's light, so the body's breathing, eating and sleeping belong to maya.

2462.reading: The great light, sole and first, abiding as Tatpara, is itself Chitpara; the knowledge that swallowed the world enters the beautiful light in the void where the pada ends, and beyond that there is nothing here to compare it with.
2462.nuance: தற்பரம் and சிற்பரம் are the Supreme as itself and as pure consciousness. தொற்பதம் is probably தொம்பதம் (the soul's pada) or தொல்பதம் (the ancient pada).

2463.reading: The ancient Vedas speak of the supreme space as his body; even one who has seen the turiyatita of the crescent-wearer, if he clings to that causal adjunct, is not pure, if you ask.
2463.nuance: Who is meant by பரனும் is unclear: the Supreme himself, said to be impure if bound to a causal adjunct, or the seer who has reached the Supreme. மிண்டின், if he clings or presses, is read either way.

2464.reading: See him as the lone Tatpara standing within space, wind, fire, water and earth; and the Shakti that is the open space standing in those same five is his form.
2464.nuance: Lines 1 and 3 are the same, so the verse places Siva and Shakti in the same five elements: he as what stands alone within them, she as the form they take.

2465.reading: For the yogi of rare austerity who thinks fully on Meru and the disc of spreading rays, if he does glorious tapas, Siva's grace becomes his own; he need not go elsewhere, for there is nothing other.
2465.nuance: Meru and the rayed disc are traditionally the crown of the yogic body and the inner sun. சிவனருள் தானாகும் may mean grace comes of itself or the yogi becomes grace. பேரவும் வேண்டாம்: no need to move or leave.

links.note: 2456 says Nandi cut away the tattvas, the two mayas and fear; 2457 adds what followed: he led the speaker beyond knowing and gave himself.
Both make Shakti the Supreme's body or form: in 2459 as his body moving in will and knowledge, in 2464 as the open space within the five elements.
Both use the crystal that shows what is near it. The Kural makes it the face showing the mind; Tirumular makes it the soul taking the colour of the Supreme it comes within.

source_issues: 2458: line 1 lists வாயு and line 2 வளி, both air, and fire is missing from the elements; one word may be corrupt.
2462: தொற்பதம் is not a known form; probably தொம்பதம் or தொல்பதம்.
